inputs:cascade/2026-10-26.description:
-selection.tsv.gz: the selection of each authority dataset (gnd, lc, geonames, viaf, wikidata, dbpedia; source, identifier, current identifier, reason, detail); entities.jsonl.gz, find-

.tsv: the Wikidata answers for the selected items; titles-.jsonl: the Wikipedia answers for the selected titles; cascade.json: rounds and sizes.
